sentences.japanese: 外に出るや否や雨が降ってきた。
sentences.english: No sooner had I gone out than it began to rain.

sentences.japanese: 我々がその戦いに勝つか否かはきわめて重要であろう。
sentences.english: It will be very important whether we win the battle or not.

sentences.japanese: 家を出るや否や激しく雨が降り出した。
sentences.english: I had no sooner left the house than it began to rain hard.

sentences.japanese: 一人になるや否や、彼女はその手紙を開いた。
sentences.english: The moment she was alone she opened the letter.

sentences.japanese: 否が応でも君はそれをしなくてはいけない。
sentences.english: You'll have to do it, whether you like it or not.
